archive-failed.body: Saving this take to your Google Drive did not finish. It retries automatically every hour; nothing is lost in the meantime.

lost.title: Lost
lost.body: Saving this take to your Google Drive failed too many times, so it is no longer being retried and the recording cannot be recovered. The student's other takes and any grade already given still stand.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.body: This recording was deleted for compliance and can no longer be played. Any grade already on it still stands.

unknown.title: Not available
unknown.body: This take cannot be played right now.

errors.noIdentifier: Cannot save: this response is missing its identifier. Reload the quiz results and try again.
errors.chooseOutcome: Choose Excuse, Blank, or Offline substitute before saving.
errors.noteRequired: An offline substitute needs a note — it is the only record of the answer.
errors.emptyAnnotations: Cannot save annotations on an empty response — the student didn't answer this question.

emptyQuestions.title: No Free Response questions in this quiz
emptyQuestions.body: Manual grading is only available for Free Response questions.

grading.noTextAnswer: The student didn't answer this question.
grading.pointsOverrideNote: Points only for this student — rubric override.
grading.tabSwitchesTitle_one: {{count}} tab switch warning during the assessment
grading.tabSwitchesTitle_other: {{count}} tab switch warnings during the assessment
grading.noAnswersOnQuestion: No answers on this question yet.

playback.failed: Your recording is still being saved — the system keeps trying on its own. Check back later.
playback.deleted: This recording has been deleted and can no longer be played.

playback.tooLarge: This recording is too large to play here. Ask your teacher to play it for you.
